# RedBridge Consulting — llms.txt
# https://redbridge-consulting.com.au
# Format: https://llmstxt.org

RedBridge Consulting is a registered Australian migration and career placement consultancy based in Melbourne, Victoria. We specialise in skilled migration pathways (subclass 189, 190, 491), employer-sponsored visas (subclass 482 and 186), and career launch programs for international students and graduates seeking permanent residency in Australia.

## Core Mission

RedBridge connects international candidates with verified Australian employers in the Accounting & Finance, ICT & Technology, and Marketing & Business sectors. We manage the full journey from career entry to permanent residency, including skills assessments, employer sponsorship, and state nomination.

## Services

- **Career Launch Program**: Work experience placement and skills development for recent international graduates who need local Australian experience to qualify for 482 visa sponsorship
- **189 Pathway (Skilled Independent)**: Points-tested independent skilled migration leading to permanent residency — no employer or state sponsor required
- **190 Pathway (State Nominated)**: State-nominated skilled migration with Victoria as primary state; provides additional points boost over the 189
- **491 Pathway (Regional Skilled)**: Regional skilled migration with additional 15 points and a pathway to permanent residency via subclass 191
- **482 / Employer Sponsored Pathway**: Temporary Skills Shortage (TSS) visa and transition to 186 Employer Nomination Scheme for permanent residency
- **For Employers**: End-to-end hiring, Standard Business Sponsorship (SBS) management, Labour Market Testing, and nomination support for Australian businesses

## Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Are job placements genuine and verified?
A: Yes. Every employer in the RedBridge network is verified before being presented to clients. Sponsorship status, role details, and business context are confirmed.

Q: What is the difference between a 482 and 186 visa?
A: The 482 is temporary employer-sponsored; the 186 is permanent residency via employer nomination. Many clients transition from 482 to 186 after 2 years with the same employer.

Q: How long does a 482 visa take?
A: Typically 3–12 months depending on employer sponsorship status, occupation, and Department processing times.

Q: Can international students apply without a job offer?
A: Yes. The Career Launch Program is designed for that earlier stage — building experience before employer sponsorship eligibility.

Q: Is the initial consultation free?
A: Yes. The first consultation with RedBridge is free with no obligation.
